p1: He sketched the men he met... before he stabbed them.
In San Francisco, 1974, men start turning up dead near Ocean Beach.
He met them after hours, in the city's gay clubs and late-night diners.
He told them he was a cartoonist.
And while they talked... he doodled.
By September 1975, at least five men are dead.
Some reports say as many as fourteen.
But at least three men survive his attacks.
In 1976, police question a strong suspect.
But the survivors won't testify. They're afraid of being outed.
In 2023, police release a new age-progressed sketch.
The reward is raised to 250,000 dollars.
If he's still alive, he's in his seventies... and the case is still open.
